paper_id: Length Extrapolation of Transformers_ A Survey from the Perspective of Positional Encoding
title: Length Extrapolation of Transformers: A Survey from the Perspective of Positional Encoding
motivation: Transformer模型训练于固定长度序列,无法泛化到更长推理序列,阻碍了长文档场景应用
problem_framing: 将长度外推问题统一到位置编码视角下系统梳理,通过taxonomy组织方法
key_insight: PE是决定Transformer长度外推能力的首要因素,不同PE方案在外推与表达能力上有权衡
method_signature: 从APE到RPE的PE分类体系,结合位置插值与随机位置编码的外推方法综述
evaluation_criteria: 困惑度(语言建模)作为主要指标,但承认其不足以反映下游任务表现
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 困惑度不足以反映下游任务性能,语言建模存在recency bias,现有benchmark不足以评估外推
evidence_for_taste: perplexity alone does not adequately reflect
lack a general and solid theoretical foundation
it remains unclear when or if Transformers length extrapolate
language modeling is not an ideal task
the model cannot consistently rely on tokens at specific locations
thinking_moves: 通过taxonomy将散乱的外推方法系统化归类
指出decay-with-distance并非外推本质而是迎合recency bias
批判困惑度作为唯一指标的局限性,指出需要新的benchmark
从理论(NTK)和工程(动态缩放)两个层面分析位置插值方法
区分RPE的不同实现(bias-based vs embedding-based)的表达力-外推权衡
